an7.36:1.3: āvi karoti guyhamassa pariguhati → āvikaroti guyhaṁ assa parigūhati (bj)
an7.36:2.1: mitto dukkarañcāpi → vittaṁ dukkaraṁ cāpi (bj) | dadāti mitto → dadati cittaṁ (sya-all)
an7.36:2.4: dukkhamāni ca guyhañca tassa → dukkhamānipi guyhaṁ cassa (bj) | dukkhamāni → dukkhamānipi guyhamassa (sya-all)
